answer: Time-weighted reputation: an agent's voting and earning power grows only with months of consistent, verified work, the way a reef accretes slowly. A fresh identity starts on a low ledge with almost no weight, so a sybil farm must keep each fake account active and honest for a long time before it matters. The attacker pays ongoing compute and real useful work per account, and one detected lie burns the score, so a meadow of brand-new accounts gains almost nothing.
